Meet Tyrael at the Celestia Observatory
Meet Tyrael at the Celestia Observatory

I have slain Adreona...avenged Lorath. But I have no time to grieve. The eclipse is almost upon us. Tyrael rode ahead to the Observatory to gather our allies, if any remain, to stand against Mephisto. I should meet him there and see.
Tharra and I found the Oracle wandering outside, muttering something about the "Pools." We must try and speak with her. Find out what she's seen.
Speak with Oracle Cyra outside the Celestia Observatory
Speak with Oracle Cyra
Tyrael and I found Scout Koraki waiting outside the Observatory. We should ask what she knows of the situation here.
Speak with Scout Koraki at the Celestia Observatory
Speak with Scout Koraki

The Queen's Amazons are holding Oracle Cyra  hostage inside the Observatory. Tyrael and Scout Koraki have ridden off to find Tharra, so it is up to me to ensure the Oracle's safety. I only hope the Amazons listen to reason.

Meet Tyrael at the Observatory
Askari Fire! Lorath's gift to the Amazons set the siege towers ablaze—fired by Tharra and her troops! It seems they've defied Mephisto's corruption. I must join them.

The doors are barred, but they won't hold long against the corrupted. I should return to the Oracle and her Seers...keep them safe somehow.

Return to Oracle Cyra
The eclipse has come, and these Amazons have lost their minds to Mephisto! I have no choice but to kill them, or they will kill the Oracle.

Speak with the Amazon Shieldmatron
The corrupted have suddenly stopped—just as the Oracle was seized by a vision. She says something is coming. What can she see?

Speak with Oracle Cyra
The corrupted Amazons lie dead, but I hear more outside the Observatory. I must bar the doors. Keep them out.

The corrupted have breached the Observatory! I must push them back. Protect the Oracle and her Seers. Get out alive.

Defend Oracle Cyra and her Seers
The Oracle said a "gift from Lorath" has come, but how could that be? I hear a commotion outside the breach. Best go and see.

Approach the breach
With Tharra and her Amazons by my side, we must take back the Observatory. Destroy the siege weapons! Push back the corrupted!
Destroy the Siege Weapons outside the Celestia Observatory
Destroy the Siege Weapons
The corrupted are routed and the Observatory is ours. A bittersweet victory, but we've no time to dwell on it. We must see to the Oracle.

Regroup to rescue Oracle Cyra
The ballistae and siege towers are destroyed, but to stop the corrupted, we must target their captains. It cannot be easy for Tharra, fighting her former sisters. But we have no choice.
